title: Life Plan Benefits Bulletin: Advance Relief on Respite and Short-Term Stays
content:
Life Plan households holding a Larkspur Entrance Fee Agreement carry their plan's rent discount into the advance on a booked stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement.

**Benefit.** The Life Plan advance relief is the rent discount of the guest's plan, taken as a percentage, for a guest holding an occupied Larkspur Entrance Fee Agreement on a lifecare plan or on a fee-for-service plan, and nothing otherwise. The rent discount is 25 percent on the LifeCare plans and 10 percent on the LifeChoice plans.

**What it reduces.** The relief is taken on the advance-nights charge — the advance nights times the nightly rate locked at booking — as it stands, and on nothing else in the advance: the advance-nights charge is multiplied by 75 percent at 25 percent and by 90 percent at 10 percent.

**Records read.** The guest's Entrance Fee Agreement, whether it is in occupied status, the contract type of its plan and that plan's rent discount.

| Entrance Fee Agreement | Contract type | Rent discount (relief) |
|---|---|---|
| Occupied, LifeCare Declining Balance Plan or LifeCare 90% Refundable Plan | Lifecare | 25 percent |
| Occupied, LifeChoice Declining Balance, 50%, 75% or 90% Refundable Plan | Fee-for-service | 10 percent |
| Not occupied, or none held | — | Nothing |

## Hypothetical illustrations (advance-nights charge 1,673.00)

- Occupied LifeCare agreement: 1,673.00 times 75 percent, that is 1,254.75.
- Occupied LifeChoice agreement: 1,673.00 times 90 percent, that is 1,505.70.
- Agreement still reserved: 1,673.00, no relief.
